description: This file defines structures and functions related to BatchedTensorImpl, which manages batched tensors with nested vmap levels, including BatchDim structures, bitset utilities, and API functions for batched tensor operations.

classes.name: BatchDim
classes.description: Represents a (level, dim) tuple indicating a batched dimension within a tensor.

classes.name: BatchedTensorImpl
classes.description: A tensor implementation that manages batched tensors with nested vmap levels, including private batch dimensions.

methods.name: BatchDim::dim
methods.description: Returns the physical dimension index being vmapped.

methods.name: BatchDim::level
methods.description: Returns the vmap level identifier.

methods.name: BatchedTensorImpl::bdims
methods.description: Returns a reference to the batch dimensions.

methods.name: BatchedTensorImpl::value
methods.description: Returns the underlying tensor.

methods.name: BatchedTensorImpl::actualDim
methods.description: Maps a public dimension index to the actual underlying tensor dimension.

methods.name: BatchedTensorImpl::strides_custom
methods.description: Overrides stride retrieval to support custom strides.

methods.name: BatchedTensorImpl::sym_is_contiguous_custom
methods.description: Checks if tensor is contiguous with a specific memory format.

methods.name: BatchedTensorImpl::set_size
methods.description: Sets the size of a specific dimension.

methods.name: BatchedTensorImpl::set_stride
methods.description: Sets the stride of a specific dimension.

methods.name: BatchedTensorImpl::set_storage_offset
methods.description: Sets the storage offset.

methods.name: BatchedTensorImpl::has_storage
methods.description: Checks if tensor has storage (debug mode).

methods.name: isBatchedTensor
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is a batched tensor.

methods.name: unsafeGetBatchedImpl
methods.description: Unsafe cast to retrieve BatchedTensorImpl from a tensor.

methods.name: maybeGetBatchedImpl
methods.description: Safely retrieves BatchedTensorImpl if tensor is batched.

methods.name: createBatchDimBitset
methods.description: Creates a bitset indicating which dimensions are batch dimensions.

methods.name: createVmapLevelsBitset
methods.description: Creates a bitset indicating which vmap levels are present.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs a BatchDim as a string.

methods.name: makeBatched
methods.description: Constructs a batched tensor from a regular tensor and batch dimensions.

methods.name: addBatchDim
methods.description: Adds a batch dimension to a tensor, returning a BatchedTensor.

methods.name: inplaceIsVmapCompatible
methods.description: Checks if in-place operations are vmap compatible.
